title: World's Finest Comics #286 DC December 1982 Superman Batman Rich Buckler Cover
condition_description: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned at the edges. See photos.
description:
World's Finest Comics #286 (December 1982), DC Comics - Superman and Batman, "All Hell Breaks Loose." Cover by Rich Buckler and Dick Giordano. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: DC Super Heroes Time Sticks / Time Capsules / Watches ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned at the edges (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
